_what: Sidecar, NOT a manifest.json. Records the QSPI flash image and the rm_nanosoc_upy stage-0 bootrom as a MATCHED PAIR. See fpga/rp/nanosoc_upy/README.md.
recorded_by: lane IMAGES, ILA mint wave (worktree feat/rm-ila-mint)
silicon_status: NOT FLASHED. Built board-free, reproducible. W1 (2026-09-24) programs it; see README.md 'W1 re-flash'.

source.firmware_micropython_uncommitted: Makefile: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH pin only (does not change the bytes when SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is passed explicitly as above)

image.reproducibility: two clean builds, different TZ (UTC / Pacific/Auckland), PYTHONHASHSEED (3 / 12345) and source paths (worktree / scratch copy): byte-identical flash_image.bin, flash_image_byte.hex, micropython_hot.bin, micropython_cold.bin, micropython_hot_word.hex
image.vs_july_image: main checkout firmware/micropython/build/xip/flash_image.bin (2026-07-15, md5 ab6b3a30e2708f96c5fbb268e4124745, crc32 0x6133A3D8) differs in EXACTLY 3 bytes: the banner date '2026-07-15' vs '2026-08-07' in the cold segment. HOT is byte-identical.

bootrom.knob: fpga/dfx/Makefile rm_nanosoc_upy: FPGA_BOOTROM_DIR=$(XIP_BOOTROM_OUT) = $(BUILD)/rm_nanosoc_upy_synth/bootrom, built at synth time by tests/micropython_flash_boot/tools/build_bootrom.sh from $SOCLABS_NANOSOC_SOC_DIR (NOT the Makefile-wide FPGA_BOOTROM_DIR default)
bootrom.reproducibility: two clean builds (TZ UTC / Asia/Tokyo, PYTHONHASHSEED 1 / 77, different out dirs): byte-identical stage0.bin/.hex, bootrom.sv, bootrom.bintxt, nanosoc_region_bootrom.v
bootrom.same_as_fielded: stage0.bin md5 is IDENTICAL to the 0x3F1A560F mint's (fpga/dfx/build_mint_2026_09/rm_nanosoc_upy_synth/bootrom), the 0xA8C1C535 mint's (build_mint/rm_nanosoc_upy_xip_synth) and the July co-sim build (tests/micropython_flash_boot/build, 2026-07-15)

clock.note: stage-0 computes BAUDDIV = NANOSOC_SYS_CLK_FREQ_HZ/38400 = 25e6/38400 = 651 (literal 0x28B in stage0.elf); at the real 50 MHz dut_clk that is 76800 baud, the shell uart_axis_shim rate, and equal to MicroPython's 651. Do NOT rebuild the bootrom with -DNANOSOC_SYS_CLK_FREQ_HZ=50000000: BAUDDIV would become 1302 (38400 baud) and the stage-0 line would garble on 6930.

expected_boot.from_image: HOT word0 (SP) = 0x18010000, word1 (Reset_Handler|1) = 0x000083B5, read from flash_image.bin @0x1000
